summary: Post-refactor regression sweep. Confirmed all 9 router modules (auth, search, products, orders, admin, suppliers, procurement, oem, agreements) registered via include_router and responding correctly after the server.py -> routes/*.py AST extraction. 138 /api/* routes exposed in OpenAPI, 26/27 pytest tests pass, 1 skip is a benign no-public-procurement-GET case. NO refactor-introduced regressions detected.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 400 from Supabase every 30 min because delivered_at column does not exist (order tracking SQL migration not yet applied). Scheduler swallows the exception (job 'executed successfully' logged) so it is GRACEFUL per task spec — flagging only for visibility. Apply the courier_name/delivered_at/completed_at/payout_eligible_at/auto_confirmed migration in Supabase to silence the recurring 400.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Apply the order tracking SQL migration in Supabase so the auto-confirm scheduler stops 400-ing every 30 min.

(Doc-only) The review-request used 'dealers' but the live endpoint is /api/admin/suppliers. /api/admin/dealers does not exist in either pre- or post-refactor code — terminology drift in the task description, not a regression.
critical_code_review_comments: include_router order in server.py (lines 1542-1571) is clean: api router first, then auth/search/products/orders/admin/suppliers, then procurement+procurement-admin, then oem+oem-admin, then agreements+agreements-admin. No prefix collisions observed.

Cross-module integrity confirmed: admin write surfaces (site-config, featured suppliers) and the public /api/featured/suppliers cached read both hit the same _FEATURED_CACHE/_SUPABASE singleton from server.py — shared kernel is intact after the AST extraction.

Auth flow on /api/auth/login is rate-limited and returns a Supabase access_token (852 chars). /api/auth/me correctly hydrates the user row from the users table and returns role='admin'. Wrong password returns 401. Missing bearer returns 401.

Procurement router uses its own custom JWT (NOT Supabase) — verified by /api/procurement/me returning 401 when called with the Supabase admin token, which is correct. Admin endpoints /api/admin/procurement/accounts and /api/admin/procurement/pending are gated by Supabase admin and return 200.

Universal search /api/search/universal?q=xerox returns the expected grouped shape (toners/printers/papers/consumables lists, all populated). AI search /api/search/ai returned 200 even without an explicit key configured — graceful.

Orders router: /api/orders is POST-only (placement), reads are /api/orders/mine (current user) and /api/admin/orders (admin). Both behave as expected and enforce auth. Status transition endpoint /api/orders/{id}/status rejects unauthenticated/invalid IDs with 401/404 rather than 500.
Suppliers storefront /api/suppliers/{id}/storefront returns business info + grouped in-stock listings as documented.

138 /api/* routes registered in OpenAPI. Every endpoint listed in the review request (universal search, listings/paginated, printers, papers, consumables, orders, featured suppliers, admin/customers, admin/finance/summary, admin/activity-log, admin/oem/pending, admin/procurement/pending, oem/public) responds 200 with admin token (or 401/403 anonymous as appropriate).
